people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Jeroboam
people.line: First king of the northern kingdom of Israel.

people.name: Nebat
people.line: Father of Jeroboam, the first king of Israel.

translations.web: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight. He didn’t depart from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin; but he walked in them.
translations.bsb: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD and did not turn away from all the sins that Jeroboam son of Nebat had caused Israel to commit, but he walked in them.
translations.kjv: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD; he departed not from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel sin: but he walked therein.
translations.asv: And he did that which was evil in the sight of Jehovah; he departed not from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, wherewith he made Israel to sin; but he walked therein.
